_comment: Instantiation manifest for report-delivery-pipeline.json - deploy one Logic App per entry, fixing its parameters as below (agent ids come out of create_agents/create_delivery_agents; drive/root ids out of setup/.env). Every pipeline enforces the same storage rule: Reports/<Supplier>/<Service>/, supplier folder reused if present, service folder created only when missing.

deepsearch-report.notes: Agent gathers public info via Bing grounding and Euronext tooling (SecurityScorecard, Defender Graph, IAF, Jira Assets CMDB, ENX gateway MCP - read-only) and emits the finished single-file HTML dashboard per the V17.02.11 template.

dpia-dpo-report.notes: OT PDF uploaded by the user (inputFileIds). Stored under Reports/DPO/<Supplier>/<Service>/ and share link sent to the DPO channel.

cyber-forum-pptx.notes: OT PDF(s) -> Infosec Cyber Forum deck for CISOs/stakeholders using the verified 8-slide governance template.

ciso-global-pptx.notes: 9-slide Global CISO deck: contract owner, impacted ENX entities, service/supplier description, risk & controls resume, internal/external exposure diagram, ICT inherent+residual scores, ENX actions to the Contract Owner.

tpa-evidence-analysis.notes: Agent enumerates Infosec Assurance/GRC/TPA/Active/<Supplier> itself via read-only Graph tools; serviceName optional at trigger but required for storage - the pipeline asks for it.

soc-report-summary.notes: User-uploaded SOC 1/2/3 report -> full findings/exceptions/CUEC summary.

pentest-report-summary.notes: User-uploaded pentest report -> normalised findings register and reliance verdict.
